title: rubus derasifolius
intro: Rubus derasifolius, commonly known as the Himalayan raspberry, is a species of plant in the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Rubus derasifolius include ellagic acid, gallic acid, and anthocyanins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties. The therapeutic actions of Rubus derasifolius may also include cardiotonic and diuretic effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
